definition: Simulates Reputation Protocol Stacks operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Reputation Protocol Stacks installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 18974 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where reputation proofs monitoring, stack logistics redundancy, or context limits maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Reputation Protocol Stacks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Reputation Protocol Stacks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Reputation Protocol Stacks — protocols for portable reputation.

Phase 1 — Prove (reputation proofs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (stack logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (context limits): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (dispute handling): stack hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and internet-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
